title: Related-Key Security of HadesMiMC
summary: The paper makes no security claim for HadesMiMC in the related-key model; establishing or refuting its security there remains open.

formal_statement.body: Establish or refute the security of HadesMiMC in an appropriate related-key model.

scope.domain: Symmetric cryptanalysis of the HadesMiMC construction under related-key attacks.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Establish or refute the security of HadesMiMC in an appropriate related-key model.

citations.label: On a Generalization of Substitution-Permutation Networks: The HADES Design Strategy

progress.summary: The source explicitly states that it makes no claims in the related-key model because it is considered irrelevant to the intended use case. It presents establishing or refuting security there as unresolved.
